Record Class GameState

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.brandeis.cosi.atg.state.GameState
Record Components:
currentPlayerName - the name of the current player
currentPlayerHand - the hand of the current player (may be null for non-current players)
phase - the current phase of the turn
availableActions - the number of actions available to the current player
spendableMoney - the amount of money available to spend
availableBuys - the number of buys available to the current player
buyableCards - the cards available for purchase
public record GameState(String currentPlayerName, Hand currentPlayerHand, GameState.TurnPhase phase, int availableActions, int spendableMoney, int availableBuys, CardStacks buyableCards) extends Record
Represents the current, immutable state of the game. When the Engine prompts a Player for a decision, it provides a GameState representing the current state of the game. The Player can use the GameState while making a decision. GameState is intentionally immutable: the only way players can modify the state of the game is to make a decision when prompted by the Engine.
